'''Joshua Whitmore''' (also published as '''Josh Whitmore''') is a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. As Josh Whitmore he played at [[April 2001 Paxtonia tournament]] on 21 April 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS with Chevins]], according to Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2124">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-paxtonia-plaza-pa-4-21-01d2124/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
